blocks.text: Solutions · Module test B1.1
Part B Script (to be read)
Invented news.
⁧١. اُفْتُتِحَ أَمْسِ فِي الإِسْكَنْدَرِيَّةِ مُلْتَقًى دَوْلِيٌّ لِلْمُتَرْجِمِينَ، بِمُشَارَكَةِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَلَاثِمِئَةِ مُتَرْجِمٍ مِنْ⁩
⁧عِشْرِينَ دَوْلَةً. وَيَسْتَمِرُّ المُلْتَقَى ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ.⁩
⁧٢. أَعْلَنَتْ شَرِكَةُ السِّكَكِ الحَدِيدِيَّةِ عَنْ تَوَقُّفِ القِطَارَاتِ بَيْنَ القَاهِرَةِ وَأَسْوَانَ يَوْمَيْنِ لِأَعْمَالِ الصِّيَانَةِ،⁩
⁧وَأَوْضَحَتْ أَنَّهُ سَيَتِمُّ تَوْفِيرُ حَافِلَاتٍ بَدِيلَةٍ لِلْمُسَافِرِينَ.⁩
⁧٣. اِسْتَقَالَ مُدَرِّبُ المُنْتَخَبِ الوَطَنِيِّ بَعْدَ خُرُوجِ الفَرِيقِ مِنَ البُطُولَةِ، وَمِنَ المُحْتَمَلِ أَنْ يُعْلَنَ اسْمُ⁩
⁧المُدَرِّبِ الجَدِيدِ الأُسْبُوعَ القَادِمَ.⁩
⁧السِّكَكُ الحَدِيدِيَّةُ⁩ The railways are the same. ⁧تَوْفِير⁩ • making available (II).
A · Reading
1. An Egyptian cultural association, in the villages of Upper Egypt; The aim is to disseminate reading among the
Children.
2. A bus turned into a library, with more than three thousand books; Every week he visits five different villages.
3. Volunteers have noted that in many villages there is no public library and that the nearest one is sometimes
50 km. In addition to the loans, she organizes reading and drawing workshops and involves mothers in activities.
4. Great welcome from the inhabitants; it is said that registered children have passed from 200 more than 1,000 in

Six months. The problem is the lack of funds: the project lives only on donations from citizens. Next month the association should launch a fundraiser to buy a second bus. Score: 2 points for complete response; 1 if one element is missing.
B · Listening
1. An international conference of translators, yesterday, in Alexandria; more than 300 translators from 20 countries; lasts three
days.
2. The suspension of trains between Cairo and Aswan for two days, for maintenance work; will be put to
provision of replacement buses.
3. The coach of the national team, after the elimination of the team from the tournament; will probably be announced the
name of the new coach.
C · Language
1. ⁧ش ف ي⁩ · 2. form VI · ⁧يَتَفَاوَضُ⁩ · 3. ⁧يَسْتَقْبِلُونَ⁩ · 4. ⁧مُنَظِّمُو المِهْرَجَانِ⁩ (also: ⁧المُنَظِّمُونَ لِلْمِهْرَجَانِ⁩ ) · 5. ⁧السُّرْعَةُ⁩

⁧المَسْمُوحُ بِهَا⁩ · 6. ⁧وُصُولُ الوَزِيرِ إِلَى القَاهِرَةِ⁩ · 7. ⁧يُرْجَى عَدَمُ التَّدْخِينِ⁩ . (also: ⁧الرَّجَاءُ عَدَمُ التَّدْخِينِ⁩ .) · 8. ⁧كُتِبَتِ الرِّسَالَةُ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ⁩ . (Also accepts ⁧كَتَبْتُ الرِّسَالَةَ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ⁩ I wrote the letter in Arabic, if the terminations are consistent) ·
D · Translation · Model version
1. All direct flights to the airport were cancelled due to the storm.
2. The Egyptian Museum in Cairo is considered one of the most important museums in the world.
3. The increase in prices has led to a decrease in the number of visitors.
4. Those responsible did not accept the residents' request to reopen the hospital.
5. The game is likely to be postponed until next week.

How to assign Accuracy. 4: all five correct sentences in the sense. 3: an inaccurate detail (e.g. reverse) instead of direct to the 1, or officials , for ⁧المَسْؤُولُونَ⁩ in 4). 2: an error that changes a part of the sense (for example in 3 The increase in visitors is either: 4 They replied without denial). 1: two or more errors of sense. Delicate points: in 1 ⁧المُتَّجِهَة⁩ is a participle with relative value; in 2 ⁧يُعَدُّ⁩ it is considered to be "is," not "is counted" and should be specified in Cairo in order not to confuse it with the Egyptian Museum of Turin; in 4 the chain ⁧لِمَطَالِبِ⁩ … ⁧بِإِعَادَةِ فَتْحِ⁩ it is to be dissolved with a verb ('to reopen') in 5 ⁧يَتِمَّ تَأْجِيلُ⁩ is a liability: it shall be postponed.
E · Written production · model
« ⁧إِيزُولَا⁩ » ⁧اِفْتِتَاحُ حَدِيقَةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ فِي حَيِّ⁩
⁧فِي مِيلَانُو، بِحُضُورِ رَئِيسِ البَلَدِيَّةِ وَمِئَاتِ⁩ « ⁧إِيزُولَا⁩ » ⁧تَمَّ صَبَاحَ أَمْسِ افْتِتَاحُ حَدِيقَةٍ عَامَّةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ فِي حَيِّ⁩
⁧السُّكَّانِ. وَقَدْ أُنْشِئَتِ الحَدِيقَةُ مَكَانَ مَوْقِفٍ قَدِيمٍ لِلسَّيَّارَاتِ، وَاسْتَمَرَّتْ أَعْمَالُ البِنَاءِ سَنَتَيْنِ. وَتَضُمُّ الحَدِيقَةُ⁩
⁧مَلْعَبًا لِلْأَطْفَالِ وَمَقْهًى صَغِيرًا وَمَسَاحَاتٍ خَضْرَاءَ لِلْمُتَنَزِّهِينَ. وَقَالَ أَحَدُ المُنَظِّمِينَ إِنَّ المَشْرُوعَ لَاقَى نَجَاحًا⁩
⁧كَبِيرًا، لِأَنَّ السُّكَّانَ شَارَكُوا فِي اخْتِيَارِ الأَشْجَارِ. لٰكِنَّ بَعْضَ المُشَارِكِينَ اشْتَكَوْا مِنْ عَدَمِ وُجُودِ مَقَاعِدَ كَافِيَةٍ.⁩
⁧وَيُقَالُ إِنَّ البَلَدِيَّةَ سَتُضِيفُ مَقَاعِدَ جَدِيدَةً قَرِيبًا. وَمِنَ المُتَوَقَّعِ أَنْ تُفْتَحَ الحَدِيقَةُ يَوْمِيًّا مِنَ السَّابِعَةِ صَبَاحًا⁩
⁧حَتَّى العَاشِرَةِ مَسَاءً.⁩

⁧مَسَاحَات⁩ • spaces, areas • ⁧المُتَنَزِّهُون⁩ "Who walks" ⁧مَقَاعِد⁩ • benches • ⁧كَافٍ⁩ • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • Elements present: title with maṣdar ( ⁧اِفْتِتَاح⁩ ); liabilities ⁧تَمَّ افْتِتَاحُ⁩ , ⁧أُنْشِئَتْ⁩ , ⁧تُفْتَحَ⁩ ; participles ⁧المُتَنَزِّهِينَ⁩ , ⁧المُنَظِّمِينَ⁩ , ⁧المُشَارِكِينَ⁩ , ⁧المُتَوَقَّع⁩ ; Weak derived verbs ⁧اِسْتَمَرَّتْ⁩ , ⁧لَاقَى⁩ , ⁧اِشْتَكَوْا⁩ , ⁧سَتُضِيفُ⁩ (IV concave); fixed expression ⁧يُقَالُ إِنَّ⁩ ; place names ⁧مَوْقِف⁩ , ⁧مَلْعَب⁩ , ⁧مَقْهًى⁩ .
F · Oral production · tutor information

Accuracy. 4: the ten difficult forms of the task 1 read almost all well (at most two errors), passive and participles corrected in the task 2, Egyptian without forms of fuṣḥā in the task 3. 3: three or four errors in the task 1, or some misconception. 2: Frequent errors that sometimes make the sense uncertain. 1: Forms of the module are not checked. Fluidity and pronunciation. 4: sliding reading, story without long breaks, g e ʾ Egyptian correct. 3: some hesitation. 2: Frequent breaks, some words difficult to understand. 1: the speech is often interrupted.
